nl: Change the schedule of the backup job in etc/cron.d/backup from 02:30 to 04:15 every day. Keep the command.
oracle_program: replace "30 2 * * * root" "15 4 * * * root" in: ["etc/cron.d/backup"] mode: literal expect: 1
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/cron.d/backup'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('30 2 * * * root') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('30 2 * * * root', '15 4 * * * root'))
EOF
